answer_text:
Among the 100 largest FHA lenders in 2025 — ranked by decisioned FHA volume in the complete CFPB HMDA file:

Highest: AmeriSave Mortgage Company — 78.7%. 18,056 denials out of 22,944 decisioned FHA applications.
Source: FinanceRateCalc analysis of CFPB HMDA 2025: "AmeriSave Mortgage Company, at 78.7% — 18,056 denials out of 22,944 decisioned FHA applications. A high observed rate reflects applicant mix, channel and documentation practice as well as underwriting, and is not evidence of wrongdoing."
The same range is confirmed in the site's reconciliation page: "Group by lei, take the 100 largest by row count, compute each denial rate. Expected range: 1.8% to 78.7%"

Lowest: Flat Branch Mortgage — 1.8%, tied with Lakeview Community Capital
Source: "Flat Branch Mortgage at 1.8%, tied with Lakeview Community Capital, among the 100 largest FHA lenders. Within the eleven-lender panel we track over time, CrossCountry is lowest at 6.4%."

Context: "Among the 100 largest FHA lenders in 2025, observed denial rates ranged from 1.8% to 78.7% — a 44-fold spread on the same federally insured program in the same year, against a national rate of 22.1%."

Denominator used for all of these: decisioned FHA forward applications = Originated (action 1) + Approved-not-accepted (action 2) + Denied (action 3), reverse mortgages excluded.
